# Atlas UI

> Atlas UI is an experimental native Rust and Slint design system. It provides
> tokens, accessible components, responsive compositions, application
> templates, and deterministic visual validation without replacing Slint.

Atlas 0.2.0 pins Rust 1.88 and Slint 1.17.1. The currently proven platform
profile is macOS arm64 with Slint's software renderer at scale factor 1. Atlas
is published on crates.io as version 0.2.0.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): vision, scope, maturity, and project positioning
- [Getting started](GETTING_STARTED.md): complete dependency and build setup
- [Agent quickstart](docs/AGENT_QUICKSTART.md): deterministic coding-agent workflow
- [Component index](docs/AGENT_COMPONENT_INDEX.md): components organized by need
- [API manifest guide](docs/AGENT_MANIFEST.md): machine-readable API lookup
- [API manifest](docs/atlas-ui-agent-manifest.json): exact component signatures and maturity
- [Compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): supported and unverified configurations
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): ownership and dependency boundaries

## Authoritative API files

- [Stable Slint facade](crates/atlas-ui-components/ui/stable.slint): SemVer-governed exports
- [Preview Slint facade](crates/atlas-ui-components/ui/preview.slint): evolving exports
- [Compiled consumer](examples/getting-started): minimal verified integration

Prefer stable exports, never infer properties from component names, keep
external effects in Rust, and configure imports with
`atlas_ui::slint_library_paths()`.
